Jordan (Sales): handing off SableBridge — 12mo, 40 seats, private deploy in eu-west-1. Key asks: SAML SSO, Splunk audit forwarding (JSON lines), and tight p50 for short prompts. They mentioned renewal sensitivity around performance.

Priya (CS): thanks Jordan. assigning Lina as CSM. Jordan, what's current provisioning status and any blockers? I'll create the onboarding runbook and weekly sync.

Jordan (Sales): legal signed, billing processed. Onboard started. Open: VPC peering, customer certs, Splunk HEC endpoint, KMS rotation policy. They want a reserved small GPU pool for peak ML-heavy hours.

Lina (CSM): i'll own the runbook. proposed plan: day0 network & access, day3 SSO & KMS, week1 pilot prompts + perf tuning, week2 staged go-live. Acceptance: SSO live, Splunk receiving JSON-lines with request_id & token counts, median latency <320ms for 6 core prompts under pilot load.

OnboardBot: provisioning update — VPC created; private control plane queued. Remaining tasks: vpn+peering, firewall rules, certs, KMS policy, Splunk ingestion. 4/10 complete.

Marco (Eng): saw their demo logs Jordan attached — streaming stalls around token ~700. Need request_ids from their env to correlate with kernel logs. Short-term mitigation: try redwood-medium-quant for pilot and enable prefix cache for their main template. Also recommend reserving a tiny dedicated pool for peak windows.

Tess (Support): opening CS ticket CS-6110 and marking ENG triage. Please paste sanitized prompt and any request_id values; I'll monitor for reproducible traces.

Jordan (Sales): sanitized snippet: `2024-07-02T11:22:10Z request_id=sb-20240702-9 model=redwood-large seq=740 latency=1370ms step=kv_fetch stream_event=stall duration=1600ms`. Demo produced ~950 tokens.

Marco (Eng): thanks. Jordan — can SableBridge run this curl from their env and paste back the response header request_id? We need it to pull host/kernel traces.

```
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<their-long-prompt>","stream":true}' -D - | head
```

- Lina: runbook + training schedule (due 2024-07-08)
- Marco: triage ENG ticket & recommend config (due 2024-07-05) — will create ENG-11001 if repro'd
